text:
elaine.marketing: OK team — finalizing announce cadence for the feature ship tomorrow. Need last-check on changelog slice, docs link, and a confirmed demo slot for the webinar. Can we lock timings by EOD PST?

sam.eng: working on the canary rollout windows now. I propose split rollout: 10% at t+30m, 50% at t+2h, full at t+6h. keeps latency risk low.

aj.docs: I pushed the docs draft to staging: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/feature-x. Changelog draft is at https://internal.redwood.ai/changelogs/feature-x-draft.md. Pls review inline comments.

diana.product: webinar slot request — can we do 11am PT? that gives NA morning + EU afternoon. That slot is open in comms calendar.

sam.eng: 11am PT works for eng to be on call. For the rollout, if webinar attendees trigger demo traffic spike, we should keep the first % low. I'll add a burst buffer rule for 15m after the webinar starts.

elaine.marketing: perfect. aj, can you ensure the staging docs have the changelog anchor and a short TL;DR for the announcement post? 1-2 bullets for the release notes.

aj.docs: yes — adding TL;DR and an examples section. Also adding a quick code snippet for the SDK: 
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate("Use-case example...", model="rwd-small")
print(resp.text)
```

elaine.marketing: thanks. quick ask re: permalinks — marketing needs a stable docs URL for the blog and social meta tags. Can we have /docs/feature-x stable by morning?

sam.eng: I can run a quick static redirect from /docs/feature-x -> staging path once aj gives final slug. low-risk. I'll coordinate with infra to push the redirect by 7am PT.

diana.product: tagging product notes — add a short known-issues blurb about tokenization edge-case and the recommended workaround, so support is prepped.

aj.docs: added Known Issues section and a small troubleshooting FAQ. Also added a section for rollback instructions (ops-runbook link).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: changelog publish job queued for 2024-10-17T07:00:00Z. CI artifact: build-572.

elaine.marketing: thanks deploy-bot. final checklist for EOD:
- marketing: write post + hero image (me)
- docs: finalize slug + TL;DR (aj)
- eng: redirect + rollout policy + burst buffer (sam)
- product: known-issues blurb (diana)

elaine.marketing: will draft the announcement copy in #marketing-drafts, tagging you all for one last pass. If anyone sees risks with timing, speak up now. :eyes: :rocket: 

sam.eng: all good from infra side. I'll monitor the canary and have a quick rollback ready. :thumbsup:

aj.docs: will do a final pass at 6:15pm PT and update the slug.

diana.product: good to go. prepping a short Q&A for the webinar.

elaine.marketing: awesome — locking this thread as the single source-of-truth for launch timing & links. I'll post the final asset list by 6:30pm PT. Thanks everyone!
